name: Tiimo
description: A visual planning app with schedules, to-do lists, focus timers, widgets and planning assistance.
intended_use: Support planning, time awareness and task organisation through a visual daily structure.
audience_or_context: Designed with ADHD and autism in mind, while also being usable by people who prefer visual planning tools.
limitations: Planning suggestions and AI-assisted features still require user judgement.
Features and platform support can change between app versions.
cost_or_access_notes: Free and paid functionality may differ; current plans and device support should be checked on the official site.
conflicts_of_interest: Tiimo is a commercial product; first-party descriptions are not independent evidence of efficacy.

provenance.method: Official resource surface and current access route checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records identity, function and access without converting first-party marketing or popularity into efficacy evidence or endorsement.
